newsitem.title: GERMANY: Munich Re says to raise 95/96 dividend to 16 marks.
newsitem.headline: Munich Re says to raise 95/96 dividend to 16 marks.

text.p: The world's biggest reinsurer, Muenchener Rueckversicherungs AG, or Munich Re, Thursday said it would raise its dividend for the 1996/1996 business year to 16 marks ($10.51) from 13 marks ($8.55).
The Munich-based giant said in a statement its profit situation had been "extraordinary" in the business year which ended June 30.
The group said the main push for its profit rise was a continued improvement in its underwriting earnings, but did not give further details. These will be given at a news conference on Nov. 11.
